shadows.name: lift

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Reserved for the single most important action on a screen. Currently used for the in-card file Download.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; background: #0284c7; color: #fbfaf7; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0369a1; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0284c7; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); transition-duration: 100ms; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default button for most actions. Sits on the page without competing.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; background: #fbfaf7; color: #374151; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 0.75rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f6f5f1; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0284c7; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary actions: nav links, dismiss buttons, low-stakes choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; background: transparent; color: #6b7280; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f6f5f1; color: #111827; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0284c7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Direction Toggle
components.description: Segmented control selecting conversion direction (Cyrillic to Latin / Latin to Cyrillic). Text-only, no icons.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 0.5rem; overflow: hidden; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-toggle__seg { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: #fbfaf7; color: #6b7280; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-toggle__seg:hover { background: #f6f5f1; color: #111827; } .ds-toggle__seg--active { background: #0284c7; color: #fbfaf7; } .ds-toggle__seg:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0284c7; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default content surface. Flat at rest, lifts on hover-capable pointers only.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fbfaf7; color: #111827; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Default textarea / input. Focus replaces the border with a Signal Blue ring.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display: block; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input-label { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #374151; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: #fbfaf7; color: #111827; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 0.75rem; font-family: inherit; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.625; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9ca3af; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0284c7; }

components.name: File Drop Zone (Empty)
components.description: Empty-state of the file uploader: dashed border, no fill, centred glyph + helper copy. The only acceptable use of a dashed line in the system.
components.html: Файл юклаш ёки бу ерга ташланг (.txt, .docx · макс 5MB)

components.name: FAQ Disclosure
components.description: Accordion item. Body animates via grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr — never animate height.
components.html: Йўқ, барча конвертация фақат сизнинг браузерингизда амалга оширилади.
components.css: .ds-faq { border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; background: #f6f5f1; border-radius: 0.75rem; overflow: hidden; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-faq__head { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.875rem 1rem; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-faq__head:hover { background: rgba(229, 231, 235, 0.4); } .ds-faq__q { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; color: #374151; } .ds-faq__chev { color: #9ca3af; flex-shrink: 0; transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-faq[data-open="true"] .ds-faq__chev { transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-faq__body { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 0fr; transition: grid-template-rows 260ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-faq[data-open="true"] .ds-faq__body { grid-template-rows: 1fr; } .ds-faq__body > div { overflow: hidden; } .ds-faq__a { margin: 0; padding: 0.25rem 1rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; color: #6b7280; }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Bottom-anchored notification. The only place a coloured side-stripe is permitted (carries semantic meaning).
components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: #fbfaf7; color: #111827; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-left-width: 2px; border-radius: 0.75rem; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), opacity 250ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-toast--affirm { border-left-color: #10b981; } .ds-toast--alert { border-left-color: #ef4444; } .ds-toast--info { border-left-color: #0284c7; }

narrative.overview:
The site should feel like a well-printed reference book opened on a desk: warm paper-white surface, generous margins, one ink color, type doing the work. Decoration is absent because it would interrupt. The user came to convert text, the way someone opens a dictionary to check a spelling — the page acknowledges that with composure, not enthusiasm.

This is a brand register where the brand is restraint. The system rejects the prevailing utility-tool aesthetic (sky-blue + Inter + check-mark feature grids + gradient text) that the current implementation partially inherits. Every change moves the page closer to a published artifact and away from a SaaS landing. Closer to Stripe's documentation set than to a Tailwind starter; closer to Are.na or a quiet editorial site than to Google Translate. The result must read as native Uzbek work, not as an English template translated into Cyrillic.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, paper-toned neutrals. Never #fff or #000. Background is paper-cream (#f6f5f1), surface is manuscript (#fbfaf7).
One committed primary, used in ≤10% of the surface. Color is signal, not decoration.
Type-led hierarchy. Scale and weight do the work shadows and color elsewhere try to do.
Generous whitespace at section seams, tight rhythm within blocks.
Motion is functional only: state changes, disclosure, toast entry and exit. No choreography, no scroll-driven effects.
Mobile-first layout: every component must survive 320px without horizontal scroll.

rules.name: The No Pure White Rule
rules.body: #ffffff and #000000 are forbidden in any surface, text, or border declaration. Pure white in light mode and pure black in dark mode read as a default, untouched template. Always tint toward warmth (light) or deep cool (dark).

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue may occupy at most 10% of any rendered viewport. Saturation is signal; if everything is blue, nothing is. When in doubt, demote a blue surface to Manuscript or a blue border to Rule.

rules.name: The Reserved Semantics Rule
rules.body: Red means error. Green means success. Neither color may be used for a non-semantic action (e.g. 'Clear' or 'Copy'). A neutral or ghost variant is always the right answer for those.

rules.name: The Two-Step Contrast Rule
rules.body: Adjacent type levels must differ by at least 1.25× in scale OR a 200-unit weight step. A 1rem 600 next to a 1rem 400 reads as flat; size it up or pull the weight further apart.

rules.name: The Cyrillic-First Test Rule
rules.body: Any candidate font must be evaluated on a real Uzbek Cyrillic string and a real Uzbek Latin string before adoption. If either renders with fallback glyphs, the font is rejected regardless of how good its Latin looks.

rules.name: The Tonal Lift Rule
rules.body: Depth between surfaces comes from the tonal step between paper-cream and manuscript, not from a shadow. If a new component needs to feel elevated, change its background to manuscript; do not reach for shadow-sm first.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: Coloured glow shadows (the boxShadow.glow token, any 0 0 Npx rgba(brand)) are prohibited. They are a 2014 SaaS reflex and undermine The Quiet Reference. The token should be deleted, not used.

dos: Do use paper-cream (#f6f5f1) as the page background and manuscript (#fbfaf7) as the surface in light mode. The warmth is identity-level, not cosmetic.
Do reserve Signal Blue for one or two real semantic moments per screen: the primary file download action, the toggle's active state, the loaded-file chip, focus rings.
Do lead hierarchy with scale and weight contrast of at least 1.25× or 200 weight units between adjacent levels.
Do test every font candidate on Ўзбек тилидаги матнларни конвертация қилиш and Oʻzbek tilidagi matnlarni konvertatsiya qilish before adoption.
Do keep motion under 260ms and bound to state, disclosure, or toast lifecycle.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion everywhere; the current global override in globals.css is non-negotiable.
donts: Don't use #ffffff or #000000 in any surface, border, or text declaration. Ever.
Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient. The .text-gradient utility and its use on the H1 arrow glyph violate this rule and should be removed.
Don't build identical card grids of icon + heading + sentence items repeated 4-8 times. The current Имкониятлар section is a textbook violation.
Don't use the .glass-card utility. Defined but unused; should be deleted before it gets adopted.
Don't use red (alert) as the default-state colour for Clear or any other recoverable destructive action. Demote to secondary or ghost and add an undo affordance instead.
Don't use green (affirm) for Copy or any non-success action. Green means something good just happened, not do something.
Don't ship two visually different primary actions for the same verb (the current implementation has a blue Download button in the file card and a green Download button in the action bar; pick one).
Don't nest cards. The card wraps a bordered input pattern in the converter is a double border.
Don't reach for shadow-sm to elevate a new surface. Use the tonal step between paper-cream and manuscript first.
Don't use sky-blue + Inter + check-mark feature grids + gradient text. That stack reads as a generic SaaS template — the exact anti-reference named in PRODUCT.md.
Don't use em dashes in UI copy or content. Use periods, commas, colons, or parentheses.
Don't add new top-level decorative effects (glow, blur, scroll-driven choreography). The Quiet Reference does not need them.
